description: This file defines a SessionModel class that manages session data, including polling for session updates, handling session actions like close and delete, and notifying listeners of changes. It also defines related types and imports external dependencies.

classes.name: SessionModel
classes.description: A class that manages browser session states, polling, and notifications.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Adds a listener for session updates and returns a function to unsubscribe.

methods.name: _notify
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of a change.

methods.name: startPolling
methods.description: Begins polling for session data every 3 seconds.

methods.name: sessionByGuid
methods.description: Retrieves a session by its GUID.

methods.name: _fetchSessions
methods.description: Fetches session data from the server and updates internal state.

methods.name: fetchSessions
methods.description: Public method to trigger session data fetch.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes a session given its descriptor.

methods.name: deleteSessionData
methods.description: Deletes data for a given session.
